title: Baseline · Sun Nov 1 (first 2.5 h): book mocks, recruiter questions, six tests
body:
Six short tests, about 2.5 hours, rated honestly. Any "Weak" moves hours toward that area in weeks 1–2 (see Replan rules).

## Setup
- [ ] Book 4 external mocks: AI coding (Nov 14), design (Nov 14), coding (Nov 19), behavioral (Nov 19)
- [ ] Send the recruiter questions from the Plan tab
- [ ] Create the AI-usage log (date, task, time saved, where AI was wrong, how you verified)
- [ ] Run the six tests below and set each rating

## Six tests
Fill **Rating** with Strong / OK / Weak. Any "Weak" fires a rule in [replan-rules.md](https://github.com/pravinadin/meta-interview-prep/blob/main/tracker/replan-rules.md).

| Area | Test | "Strong" means | Rating | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coding speed | LC 1249 and 314 in C++, 25 min each, no AI | Both pass, clean code, complexity stated |  |  |
| C++ fluency | From memory in 15 min: min-heap with comparator, grid BFS, string split | No lookups, compiles first or second try |  |  |
| AI-enabled coding | Have an AI generate a buggy ~100-line C++ module with tests; fix it in 30 min | All tests green; you found bugs by reading, not by asking |  |  |
| System design | Rate limiter in 30 min, Mermaid diagram | Requirements, API, diagram and one deep dive all fit |  |  |
| In-domain design | Talk through a telemetry pipeline for 100K devices, 15 min | Clear structure, tradeoffs named, no rambling |  |  |
| Behavioral | Tell the multipath-redesign story aloud, recorded | Under 3 min, clear "I", a number in the result |  |  |

_From the Tracker tab of the Meta Interview Prep plan._
